title: The Information Content of News Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.33458v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does the predictive success of news embeddings reflect a better measure of news surprises or other sources of return predictability in text? We decompose news embeddings by content into event-category, firm-identity, and idiosyncratic components, and by timing into historical levels and current deviations. At short horizons, event categories account for most of the predictive power of embedding forecasts, and simple forecasts based on historical average returns after news in each event category outperform them. At longer horizons, firm information already present in earlier news coverage accounts for a substantial share of return predictability, even after residualization on firm characteristics. The dominance of event categories persists, and historical levels still contribute in the first months, when using a language model pretrained entirely before our sample period. translated_abstract: 新闻嵌入的预测成功，究竟是因为它们更好地度量了新闻意外，还是源于文本中其他收益可预测性的来源？我们将新闻嵌入按内容分解为事件类别、公司身份和特异成分，并按时间分解为历史水平与当前偏离两部分。研究发现在短期范围内，事件类别解释了嵌入预测的大部分预测能力，而基于每类事件后历史平均收益的简单预测甚至优于嵌入预测。在更长期范围内，早期新闻报道中已包含的公司信息解释了相当大比例的收益可预测性，即使在对公司特征进行残差化之后依然如此。即便使用完全在样本期之前完成预训练的语言模型，事件类别的主导地位依然存在，历史水平在最初几个月内仍有贡献。对于 Llama-2，即使是由三年以上之前的新闻构建的嵌入……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献在于将新闻嵌入按内容（事件类别、公司身份、特异成分）和时间（历史水平与当前偏离）进行分解，发现其收益预测能力主要来自事件类别以及早期报道中已有的公司信息，而非真正新的新闻意外信息。
en_tdlr: By decomposing news embeddings into event-category, firm-identity, and idiosyncratic components across timing dimensions, this paper shows that their return predictability stems mainly from event categories and firm information already present in earlier coverage, rather than from fresh news surprises.
